title: Declined Monthly Fees, Past-Due Status and Reinstatement
content:
**Tailwise Vet Clinic Wellness Plans — billing and collections terms.**

A declined monthly fee is retried for the plan's retry period, then the plan goes past due and no included service or discount may be used. Paying every overdue month reinstates the plan with no late fee. After the plan's past-due grace period the plan is cancelled for non-payment and settled like an early cancellation.

## Periods and fees by plan

| Plan | Retry period for a declined monthly fee | Past-due grace period before cancellation for non-payment | Late fee on a past-due month | Included services and discounts while past due |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Puppy Wellness Plan | 5 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 0.00 USD | Not available |
| Kitten Wellness Plan | 5 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 0.00 USD | Not available |
| Adult Dog Wellness Plan | 5 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 0.00 USD | Not available |
| Adult Cat Wellness Plan | 5 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 0.00 USD | Not available |
| Senior Dog Wellness Plan | 5 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 0.00 USD | Not available |
| Senior Cat Wellness Plan | 5 calendar days | 30 calendar days | 0.00 USD | Not available |

## Status path

| From | To | What moves the plan |
|---|---|---|
| Active | Past due | A monthly fee is still declined after the 5 retry days; the declined month is recorded |
| Past due | Active | The overdue fees are paid — every overdue month — and the plan is reinstated |
| Past due | Cancelled | 30 days past due run out; the plan is cancelled for non-payment and settled like an early cancellation |

## Reinstatement terms

- Reinstatement requires payment of every overdue month, not some of them. Each overdue month paid is charged as a plan fee for that month.
- No late fee is added on reinstatement: the late fee is 0.00 under every plan.
- On reinstatement the next payment date becomes the next unpaid month.

## Hypothetical illustration

A Kitten Wellness Plan is past due with two overdue months of 34.95 each. Paying both months, 69.90 in total, reinstates the plan with no late fee; paying one month only does not meet "every overdue month". While the plan remained past due, no included service could be redeemed and no plan discount applied.
